snippet.description:
Castelian was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in June 1991. All audio/visual elements copyright 1991, Triffix. Music composed by ?

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT CASTELIAN (NES)

Alien towers have sprouted up across the island. Now, you must climb to the top of eight towers and detonate powerful bombs. As you climb the tower, I-Balls, Spheroids, and dissolving pathways threaten your very existence. However, you can fire Carbonobombs, use high speed elevators, and escape into doorways to avoid these obstacles. See if you can destroy the towers in CASTELIAN. Eight towers; detonate powerful bombs; avoid a variety of enemies; fire Carbonobombs; ride in an elevator; escape into doorways.

AKA: Nebulus, Subline, Tower Toppler, Kyoro-Chan Land
